context.title: 03 DDD — Context authority (draft)
context.subtitle: Media Management owns access and source intent. Processing owns valid attempts and outputs.
nodes:
Web + Publisher CLI
HTTPS cookie session

MEDIA MANAGEMENT
Account + Asset + delivery
Public /jobs id = AssetId
Durable pending submissions

PROCESSING
Internal JobId is separate
Jobs + attempts + output refs
Own queue, workers and reaper

media_db — MM role
Account / Asset / submission intent
Own migration history

processing_db — P role
Job / attempts / output refs
Own migration history
notes:
Translation: MM combines Asset + live Processing result on read; submitted outage returns 503.
Pending maps to queued/pending; error maps to failed/error. No stored encode-state cache.
Source access: MM checks local owner/revision/deletion; P checks its current reserved attempt.

aggregates.title: 03 DDD — Aggregates and invariants (draft)
aggregates.subtitle: Logical consistency boundaries; identifiers cross contexts, tables and credentials do not.
nodes:
MM: ACCOUNT ROOT
OwnerId + account identity
Credentials stay in MM

MM: ASSET ROOT
Public AssetId + OwnerId
Immutable source + revision
Pending intent + deletion state

MM: READ-TIME PUBLIC VIEW
Asset + live Processing result
No stored encode-state cache

P: PROCESSING JOB ROOT
Internal JobId != public AssetId
Unique AssetId + owner + revision
Authoritative job state

P: ATTEMPT ENTITY
Reserved queued ID on submit/retry
Claim retains that ID + sets lease

P: OUTPUT SET VALUE
Winning primary ref; optional HLS
Plain MP4 / inherited MKV or MP3
notes:
Queue delivery carries (job_id, attempt_id); claims and results must match the current reserved ID.
Plain uploads require MP4. Inherited conversion edits retain MKV/MP3 primary output compatibility.

lifecycle.title: 03 DDD — Submission and processing (draft)
lifecycle.subtitle: Asset handoff state and Processing state describe different facts. A submitted Asset can have a failed job.
nodes:
MM: PENDING
Source + intent durable
Public: queued / pending

MM: SUBMITTED
Live Processing read
Downstream outage: 503

MM: ERROR
Permanent handoff rejection
Public: failed / error

P: PROCESSING
Claim keeps reserved AttemptId
Current valid lease

P: DONE
Primary output committed
Optional HLS

P: FAILED
Safe failure reason
Source retained

OLD ATTEMPT RESULT
Wrong AttemptId / expired claim
Reject publication; reconcile orphan objects
notes:
SubmitJob / new RetryJob reserves the queued attempt; RQ carries (job_id, attempt_id).
Missing delivery re-enqueues the same pair. Retry request replay reserves no additional attempt.
Only winning refs publish: MP4 for plain upload; MKV/MP3 for inherited conversion edits.
